thread:
maya: FYI canary deploy ~10:15 — console charts (heatmap + line) are taking 2-6s to initialize for me. feels like main-thread parse + canvas bind.
kevin: ugh. any stack or timeline? UI traces?
maya: quick snippet from devtools timeline: 
```
Main thread: EvaluateScript (bundle.js) 1120ms
InstantiateWASM fast-wasm-renderer.wasm 760ms
CanvasRenderer.bind() 428ms
kvcache.save(prefixes) 412ms
FirstPaint delayed ~2100ms
```
kevin: that wasm instantiate time is killer. which PR introduced fast-wasm-renderer?
natalie: that was my PR (562) — the wasm lib improved draw perf post-initialization but the artifact size jumped. gzipped wasm + glue ~1.8MB. my bad, I didn't test cold-start on low-end machines.
sam: also seeing a spike in KV caching serialization on first paint. the kvcache.save call blocks the worker handoff. stack shows synchronous stringify on main thread.
maya: repro steps: open a new workspace w/ heatmap, cold cache, on EU canary. consistently repro.
kevin: can we toggle to an older rendering path via routing/variant? e.g. route heatmap to `widget.canvas-legacy` temporarily?
natalie: we don't have a route for that heatmap variant wired in the rollout policy. last time we relied on client feature flags only.
kevin: we should be able to add an emergency routing rule in the platform to map heatmap -> legacy for canary and prod. low-risk and quick. ops-bot: Deploy canary 4298765400 started by @ci — 20% traffic to canary.
maya: mitigation checklist: 1) rollback PR562 (quick) 2) add routing override 3) debounce KV.save off critical path 4) prefetch wasm using <link rel=preload> or importScripts in worker.
sam: quick experiment — if we defer kvcache.save until after first paint, cold startup drops ~1s locally.
natalie: I'll prepare a micro-patch to lazy-init the wasm and move expensive JSON serialization off main thread (worker). It won't land in canary before EOD though.
kevin: I'll open a platform routing override ticket and try to push a temporary rule. If we can flip canary to legacy heatmap, we can validate rollback impact quickly.
maya: telemetry asks — can we add a short metric: first-paint, wasm-init-duration, kvcache-save-duration? we need numbers across regions.
kevin: agreed. I'll add a thin telemetry probe (console-telemetry) to the client and wire a short-term sample to the console dashboard so we can monitor.
ops-bot: @maya rolled back release 4298765400 -> 4298765200 (actioned)
maya: rollback done. heatmap init back to ~300-600ms. leaving canary to watch.
natalie: still going to push the worker-serialization fix as follow-up — notebook with perf numbers coming.
sam: once worker fix lands, let's also add a small prefetch config for wasm in the CDN so instantiation overhead is lower on cold clients.
kevin: follow-ups: (a) routing override ticket (#PLAT-987) (b) telemetry probe PR (#CRIT-118) (c) natalie micro-patch PR (#563) (d) postmortem if we see more than 5% user impact in 24h. assigning: kevin -> PLAT-987, maya -> verify rollback, natalie -> PR563, sam -> worker refactor.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll leave monitoring on for next 4 hours and ping if anything else shows up. :eyes:
